02/10.01.2025

2.  The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Cyber P.S. Case No. 87/2023, for the offences registered under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120(B) of the I.P.C.& 66(B), 66(C),
66(D), 84(C) of the I.T. Act, pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II, Deoghar.
3.
Bail Application of the petitioner was earlier rejected by this Court vide B.A. No. 1670 of 2024 by order dated 07.05.2024.

4. On 19.12.2023, at about 10:00 a.m., Cyber Police, Deoghar, on the basis of confidential information that cyber criminals have assembled near Aasna More, Chowk and were committing cyber-crime, raided the place of occurrence and apprehended this petitioner along with other co-accused persons.
Mobile phones and e-gadgets were recovered from the possession of the accused persons.
It appears that the mobile phones recovered from the possession of the petitioner were used in cheating innocent persons.

sentences.text: It was submitted that the petitioner has remained in custody for more than a year.
6. Considering the period of custody, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II, Deogharin connection with Cyber P.S. Case No. 87/2023.
